normalization_plan.reason: tokenId is only used inside depositToExchange for the approved-owner check, transferFrom and listing writes
price is only used to build SaleData during depositToExchange
totalToPay is a transient price+fee value fully local to purchaseToken
sale is a memory snapshot of market[tokenId] read only within purchaseToken
blockNumber is the stored feeding block used only for the elapsed-block and blockhash logic in stopFeeding
newHorse is only pushed into all_horses inside addHorseIndex
renamingFee is a local cost value computed and refunded only inside renameHorsey
balance is a local cache of _cBalance[msg.sender] used only for the transfer in withdrawCeo
knightPayday exists solely to credit knightAddress during distribution
paladinPayday exists solely to credit paladinAddress during distribution
jokerPayday is the residual share credited to jokerAddress during distribution
item is only compared against array entries inside _indexOf
array is only iterated inside the pure helper _indexOf
barnArray is the storage reference shifted and truncated inside _removeTokenFromBarn
newOwner is validated and written to the owner state variable inside transferOwnership
newName is only used for the byte-length fee and stables.storeName in renameHorsey
newAddress is only forwarded to _addLegitOwner from addLegitDevAddress
parameter is stored in currentProposal and consumed later by _doProposal
methodId is stored in currentProposal and selects the privileged call executed by _doProposal
